component.name: Beamcam
component.summary: Use your Android phone as a webcam

description.p: Turn your Android phone into a wireless webcam for video calls, your browser and any other app that uses a camera. Open the app on your phone and on your computer, click Connect, and pick the “Beamcam” camera.
Beamcam now comes for Fedora too, and helps you when Secure Boot blocks the virtual camera driver.
The first public version: use your Android phone as a webcam over your Wi-Fi.
